name: Abyssinian
description: The Abyssinian is easy to care for, and a joy to have in your home. They are affectionate cats and love both people and other animals.

name: Bengal
description: Bengals are a lot of fun to live with, but they're definitely not the cat for everyone, or for first-time cat owners.

name: Birman
description: The Birman is a docile, quiet cat who loves people and will follow them from room to room.

name: British Shorthair
temperament: Affectionate, Easy Going, Gentle, Loyal, Patient
description: The British Shorthair is a calm and undemanding companion with a famously round face.

name: Maine Coon
description: Maine Coons are known as the gentle giants of the cat world and are exceptionally good with children.

name: Norwegian Forest Cat
description: The Norwegian Forest Cat is a sweet, loving cat who appreciates praise and likes to be with people.

name: Persian
description: Persians are sweet, gentle cats who prefer a serene home where little changes from day to day.

name: Ragdoll
description: Ragdolls love their people, greeting them at the door and following them around the house.

name: Siamese
temperament: Active, Agile, Clever, Sociable, Loving, Energetic
description: While Siamese cats are extremely fond of their people, they will follow you around and supervise your every move.

name: Siberian
temperament: Curious, Intelligent, Loyal, Sweet, Agile, Playful
description: The Siberian is a slow-maturing breed, taking as long as five years to fully develop.

name: Sphynx
description: The Sphynx is an extrovert who demands attention and behaves more like a dog than a cat.

name: Tonkinese
temperament: Curious, Intelligent, Lively, Outgoing, Playful, Social
description: Tonkinese are the busybodies of the cat world, wanting to be involved in everything you do.
